# block 2 (200 of 33684): the following entry fails with llvm-libc db0b0e2 / (fixed in https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/221012)
# block 3 (200 of 2684): floating-point numbers in [2^(e-1),2^e) which are closest to an even/odd / multiple of pi/2 (generated by wc() in sin.sage)
